gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (GPU 0 of the reference host, compute mode Default)
limit_scope: per client process: two concurrent clients each held 1.5 GiB under a 2 GiB limit
two_private_daemons_same_gpu: both work, each enforcing its own limit
conclusion: MPS enforces a hard per-process VRAM ceiling on GeForce, set server-side so the client cannot raise it, but a client that does not connect to the daemon escapes it unless the GPU is in EXCLUSIVE_PROCESS mode, which admits one MPS server (one UID) per GPU at a time.
